title: VectorStore
description: The vector store the launcher runs for the knowledge bases on a machine, each knowledge base's index in collections of its own. It belongs to no knowledge base, so its document is kept in the launcher's state home, in `stack/vectors.yaml`, not in a knowledge base's repository. A knowledge base keeps its index in it by naming `shared` at `spec.vectors`.

spec.description: The vector store, and where it is published.

port.description: The port the vector store is published on, on this machine, where every knowledge base's Smelter and Librarian reach it.
